title: Regional MSL Manager, Neuroscience (Europe)
description:
**Description**


We are seeking an experienced and scientifically credible Regional MSL Manager to lead and support a team of Medical Science Liaisons across Europe within Neuroscience and Psychiatry.  

This role will focus on leveraging field medical expertise to accelerate clinical trial delivery through investigator engagement, site support, patient identification, enrolment, and retention initiatives for priority neuroscience programmes. The Regional MSL Manager will combine people leadership responsibilities with a strong operational focus, ensuring the field medical team effectively supports clinical development objectives whilst maintaining high\-quality scientific exchange with healthcare professionals and external stakeholders.


Working closely with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and external study partners, the successful candidate will lead strategies that enhance study site performance, support patient recruitment goals, and generate valuable scientific insights from the field. The individual will remain closely connected to field activities, providing coaching and support to MSLs while driving excellence in trial support, stakeholder engagement, compliance, and execution.  

This position offers an opportunity to lead a high\-performing field medical team while contributing directly to the successful execution of clinical programmes and improved outcomes for patients living with neurological and psychiatric disorders.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Medical Science Liaisons across multiple European markets.
* Provide day\-to\-day line management, performance support, field coaching, and professional development for MSL team members.
* Develop and implement regional field medical strategies that support patient identification, enrolment, retention, and overall clinical trial execution.
* Partner closely with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and study teams to identify and address barriers to site activation and patient recruitment.
* Ensure MSLs maintain effective territory engagement plans with investigators, research centres, and referral networks to support study objectives.
* Support study feasibility assessments and site identification activities by leveraging scientific expertise and field insights.
* Facilitate compliant scientific engagement with Principal Investigators, study coordinators, healthcare professionals, and research site personnel.
* Accompany MSLs in the field to enhance scientific engagement capabilities and ensure consistent execution of best practices.
* Gather, analyse, and communicate actionable field insights relating to study execution, recruitment challenges, treatment pathways, and investigator needs.
* Work collaboratively with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Market Access, and Commercial teams to ensure aligned execution of programme objectives.
* Support clinical study steering committees, investigator meetings, advisory interactions, and other study\-related activities as appropriate.
* Define, monitor, and report key performance indicators related to field medical activities, site engagement, recruitment support, and team effectiveness.
* Support onboarding, training, and capability development programmes for new and existing MSL team members, including clinical trial support competencies.
* Ensure all activities are conducted in full compliance with applicable regulations, industry codes, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), pharmacovigilance requirements, and company policies.

**Requirements:**

* Advanced scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, MBBS, MSc, or equivalent).
* Previous experience as a Medical Science Liaison with demonstrated success in a field medical role.
* Prior line management, team leadership, or mentoring experience within Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or Field Medical organisations.
* Strong scientific knowledge within Neuroscience, Psychiatry, or related therapeutic areas.
* Experience supporting clinical research, clinical trial execution, site engagement, patient recruitment, or investigator\-sponsored studies.
* Working knowledge of clinical development processes, trial operations, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP).
* Experience collaborating with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, and cross\-functional study teams.
* Proven ability to engage effectively with healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, investigators, and research site personnel through scientific exchange.
* Ability to translate field insights into meaningful recommendations that support both Medical Affairs and Clinical Development objectives.
* Strong communication, coaching, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within complex cross\-functional pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.
* Solid understanding of compliance, pharmacovigilance, and ethical requirements governing medical activities and clinical research interactions.
* Ability to operate effectively across multiple countries and cultures within a matrix organisation.
* Fluency in English; additional European languages are advantageous.


Willingness to travel extensively across Europe. This role offers the opportunity to shape regional neuroscience strategy, lead diverse international medical teams, and drive scientific excellence across multiple global markets while improving outcomes for patients affected by neurological and psychiatric disorders.

* Ensure training and sales enablement priorities are aligned with global capability frameworks, standards, and strategic initiatives

**Organizational Setting**


The Office of Climate Change, Biodiversity and Environment (OCB) works to ensure that countries and stakeholders respond to the challenges of climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental degradation. OCB provides a cross organizational coordination role on these issues and is the focal point to major multilateral environmental agreements including the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change Conferences (UNFCCC), and the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD). The Office also assists FAO Members in their responses towards the interlinked challenges of food security, climate change, biodiversity loss and environmental degradation including through facilitating access to climate and environmental financing such as the Global Environment Facility (GEF) and the Green Climate Fund (GCF). In addition, OCB hosts the Globally Important Agricultural Heritage Systems (GIAHS) Programme, the Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture and the Commission on Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture as well as FAO’s work on environmental safeguards and leads the Programme Priority Areas on Climate Change (PPA BE1\) and Bioeconomy for Sustainable Food and Agriculture (PPA BE2\).


The GIAHS Secretariat serves as the operational unit of FAO’s Globally Important Agricultural Heritage Systems (GIAHS) Programme. It provides guidance and technical support to FAO Members in developing and submitting GIAHS proposals and implementing follow\-up activities for designated sites. The Secretariat also liaises with governments and national and international organizations to establish strategic partnerships that support the Programme’s continued development and geographical expansion.


The position ‘GIAHS Agro\-economic Specialist’ is in the Globally Important Agricultural Heritage Systems (GIAHS) Secretariat, in FAO Headquarters in Rome.

  

  

**Reporting Lines**


The incumbent will report to the Senior Coordinator of the GIAHS Secretariat.

  

  

**Technical Focus**


Support the GIAHS Secretariat in developing practical tools, a comprehensive framework and technical guidelines for the branding, informative labelling, marketing and commercialization of products originating from GIAHS sites.

  

  

**Tasks and responsibilities**


* Conduct consultations and interviews with relevant stakeholders, national institutions, GIAHS communities and members of the Scientific Advisory Group (SAG) to collect data and information on value addition and the branding, labelling, marketing and commercialization of GIAHS products.

• Complete the collection, processing and analysis of data from GIAHS sites to map the current status of the branding, labelling, marketing and commercialization of products originating from these sites.
  

• Complete the analysis of data from GIAHS sites and revise and strengthen the previous consultant’s draft report on the economic, institutional and policy measures required to ensure the long\-term sustainability of GIAHS systems.
  

• Build on the previous consultant’s work to develop a comprehensive framework and technical guidelines for the branding, informative labelling, marketing and commercialization of products originating from GIAHS sites.
  

• Prepare a policy brief outlining appropriate measures to ensure the long\-term sustainability of GIAHS systems, conserve biodiversity, strengthen food security and improve the livelihoods of GIAHS communities.
  

• Participate in interview panels for the recruitment of affiliate personnel (but not staff members)
  

• Represent FAO at relevant meetings and international conferences, as required.
  

• Perform any other related duties, as required.

Consultants with bachelor\`s degree need two additional years of relevant professional experience

**Technical/Functional Skills**


* Work experience in more than one location or area of work, particularly in field\-based positions, is desirable.

• Relevant professional experience in developing frameworks, technical guidelines and practical tools for the branding, labelling, marketing and commercialization of agricultural products.
  

• Extent and relevance of experience in collecting, processing and analysing data and information on value addition and the branding, labelling, marketing and commercialization of agricultural products.
  

• Demonstrated experience in reviewing technical documents and reports and preparing technical reports and policy briefs on the economic, institutional and policy measures required to strengthen value chains, improve market access and enhance the positioning of agricultural products.
  

• Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing labelling, certification or origin\-based quality schemes for agricultural products.
  

• Extent and relevance of experience working with national institutions and local communities in agriculture, forestry, fisheries, biodiversity conservation, natural resource management and/or rural development.
  

• Extent and relevance of experience in organizing technical meetings and presenting technical findings and reports at conferences, workshops and seminars.
  

• Strong analytical, drafting and report\-writing skills.

• Familiarity with FAO’s GIAHS Programme and its areas of work is considered an asset.

***Junior Cybersecurity Architect***

***"Implementare tecnologie innovative e integrarle sui sistemi dei clienti, ma anche trovare nuovi modi di adattarle alle loro esigenze: questo è il mio lavoro ideale!"***

Se ti rivedi in questa descrizione, continua a leggere per scoprire chi siamo e quali opportunità possiamo offrirti!  



  

Hai già sentito parlare di BIP CyberSec? È il Centro di Eccellenza di BIP Group specializzato in servizi e soluzioni per il contrasto delle minacce provenienti dal cyber space.
  

  

Siamo nati dall’incontro di tre aree di competenza: **Cyber Security** **Strategy** **,** **Technology** **e Cyber Defense** e stiamo cercando un **Junior Cybersecurity Architect** che entri a far parte del nostro **team Technology** e contribuisca insieme a noi a proteggere il business dei nostri clienti.  

  

  



**Accetti la sfida?**

Come **Security Architecture Specialist** , entrerai all'interno del cluster **Technology** , che offre servizi di scouting, selezione e implementazione di tecnologie innovative in grado di **mitigare i rischi di attacchi cyber avanzati** , indirizzando quanto richiesto dalle normative e suggerito dai principali standard internazionali in ambito security.  

  

  



**Sarai tu ad entrare nel nostro Team?**

Hai l’abilità di pensare “out of the box”, hai voglia di mettere in campo le tue idee e le tue capacità, ti piace lavorare con gli altri, sei una persona determinata e ti appassionano innovazione e tecnologie?  

  

  



**Cosa ci aspettiamo da te:**

* Supportare allo sviluppo e all'implementazione di strategie, policy e procedure di sicurezza informatica complete e allineate alle best practice del settore.
* Supportare alla progettazione di soluzioni sicure per reti, infrastrutture, cloud e applicazioni, garantendo la riservatezza, l'integrità e la disponibilità di sistemi e dati
* Supportare le attività “audit\-like” per appurare l’effettivo soddisfacimento di requisiti di Information/Cyber Security
* Effettuare assessment dei rischi e delle vulnerabilità nell'ambiente IT delle organizzazioni dei nostri clienti, identificando le potenziali minacce e raccomandando le opportune contromisure.
* Supportare il cliente nella definizione di misure di sicurezza “compensative”
* Partecipare alla valutazione, alla selezione e all'implementazione di tecnologie legate alla sicurezza, tra cui firewall e WAF, sistemi di rilevamento delle intrusioni, strumenti di crittografia, strumenti di scansione delle vulnerabilità e sistemi di gestione delle identità e degli accessi.

* Svolgere il ruolo di Subject Matter Expert, fornendo indicazioni e raccomandazioni sui rischi di sicurezza informatica, sulla conformità e sui requisiti normativi (PCI\-DSS v4\.0, SWIFT, GDPR, PSD2\).
Collaborare con i revisori esterni e gli enti normativi durante gli audit e le valutazioni di sicurezza per garantire la conformità agli standard.

**Di seguito puoi approfondire i requisiti e le caratteristiche della persona che stiamo cercando:**

* Laurea triennale e/o specialistica in ambito STEM
* Massimo 2 anni di esperienza nella progettazione e implementazione di soluzioni Cloud / Network / Infrastructure Security, Security Architecture o System Integration di componenti di sicurezza
* Conoscenza ad alto livello delle best practice (sia tecnologiche che organizzative) relative ai domini di sicurezza (IAM, Logging and Monitoring, Network Security, Security Architecture, Endpoint Security, Supply Chain Security) e degli standard di settore (ad esempio, ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP).
* Capacità relazionali e di sintesi (in particolare in sede di reporting) e predisposizione a trasmettere concetti di sicurezza complessi a interlocutori tecnici e non. Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere decisioni o gestire escalation con una supervisione minima
* Approccio proattivo per rimanere aggiornati sulle ultime tecnologie di sicurezza, sulle vulnerabilità e sulle tendenze del settore.

**Verrà considerato un plus:**

Conoscenza delle certificazioni di sicurezza : I TIL Fundamentals e ITIL Service Design, TOGAF, Microsoft SC\-100, CCSP / CCSK, certificazioni di rete.  

* 

**Cosa possiamo prometterti:**

* Non sarai mai un numero, anche se i numeri (binari) per noi contano.
* Le vulnerabilità sono un problema, ma solo quelle dei nostri clienti. Le tue cercheremo di superarle con il gioco di squadra!

Inoltre, la crescita in BIP CyberSec prevede un piano di formazione continuo con l’obiettivo di sviluppare nuove competenze e conoscenze in ambito cybersecurity, anche attraverso il conseguimento delle più importanti certificazioni di settore (es. GICSP, GCIH, OSCP, CEH)

La nostra avventura è iniziata nel 2013 in Italia, dall'idea un gruppo all'avanguardia di BIP, desiderosi di creare un impatto reale nella gestione e protezione dei rischi informatici, consapevoli che la cybersecurity sarebbe presto diventata una questione centrale per le aziende in tutto il mondo.

Etica dell'Hacking, per prevenire e rispondere alle minacce h24

**➡ Candidati ora!**

In BIP mettiamo le persone al centro. Offriamo un ambiente sfidante e meritocratico, dove la collaborazione e lo spirito imprenditoriale vengono valorizzati ogni giorno.

description:
TXT Group is an international, IT end\-to\-end provider of consultancy, software solutions and services, supporting the digital transformation of customers’ products and core processes. With a proprietary software portfolio and deep expertise in vertical domains, TXT Group operates across different markets, with a growing footprint in Aerospace, Aviation, Defense, Industrial, Government and Fintech. The holding company, TXT e\-Solutions, has been listed on the Italian Stock Exchange \- STAR segment (TXT.MI) \- since July 2000\. TXT Group headquartered in Milan and has subsidiaries in Italy, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and the United States of America.
  
  

**Quality Engineer:**  

For one of our key clients operating in the Defence sector, we are looking for a Quality Engineer to support the entire product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with quality, contractual, and regulatory requirements.
  
  

**Main Responsibilities:**  

Act as the Quality focal point and interface with Engineering teams.
  
Participate in project reviews and technical review boards.
  
Support development\-to\-production transition activities.
  
Verify and assess product documentation packages and deliverables.
  
Perform product acceptance and inspection activities.
  
Participate in qualification and validation testing campaigns.
  
Define, collect and report quality metrics and performance indicators.
  
Support the update and maintenance of Quality Management Plans and related documentation.
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Solid knowledge of system lifecycle processes according to MIL\-STD\-2167A and MIL\-STD\-498 standards.
  
Previous experience in Defence environments and familiarity with the processes typically adopted in military programs.
  
Knowledge of Quality Assurance procedures, methodologies, and processes.
  
Experience in Verification and Acceptance activities.
  
Knowledge and management of Quality Notifications (QN).
  
Familiarity with processes and documentation related to ADP, CVS, TDR, and QTR.
  
Ability to monitor product and process compliance against contractual and regulatory requirements.
  
Experience in managing non\-conformities and corrective actions.
  
Knowledge of quality documentation and operational practices within Defence programs.
  
Ability to prepare and manage quality reports, metrics, and KPIs.
  
Experience supporting audits, program reviews, and compliance verification activities.
  
Continuous improvement mindset and commitment to maintaining high\-quality standards.
  
  

**Soft Skills:**  

Teamwork and collaboration skills.
  
Reliability and accountability.
  
Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
  
Attention to detail and a quality\-oriented mindset.
  
Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  

**Education:**  

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
  

**Why choose TXT Group:**  

Career opportunities in a fast\-growing and rapidly changing company with young, international staff
  
Training on business\-related topics
  
Corporate Benefits (health insurance, welfare, Ticket Restaurant, discounts as a group employee)
  
The contract offered for this position is a permanent one, and the salary range for this position is between EUR 40\.000 € and EUR 45\.000 € gross per year.
  
The grading/level will be defined during the selection process based on the candidate's profile and in accordance with the National Collective Labor Agreement (Metalworking Industry).
  
  

Position is open to all applicants regardless of gender, in accordance with Italian Legislative Decree 198/2006\. The company promotes equal opportunities and values diversity in all its forms.
